description: GWELLS is the British Columbia government's public groundwater-well and aquifer information system. It holds construction, alteration and decommissioning details submitted under provincial water rules and exposes public well and aquifer records through a documented REST API. Users can query all wells or select a bounding box and obtain mapped well information for a study area. Geographic coverage is British Columbia, and time coverage follows submitted records, not a continuous hydrological time series. The API states Open Government Licence - British Columbia for the data, and the separate application source is Apache-2.0. Both are free to access. A limitation is that record completeness depends on reporting; registration was voluntary before February 2016, and the inventory does not prove current groundwater yield or quality. GWELLS supports water-supply vulnerability scenario analysis by locating wells and aquifers. The catalogue's data-era5-reanalysis is a distinct meteorological series, not a well inventory. No API data dump was downloaded.
